selection_rule: First ten collected reference IDs in ascending source order; full 50 pool replayed for context, no success-based reselection.
reference_horizon: max(300, number_of_reference_actions + 200); no added opening or withdrawal
fixture_rule: Initialize upright bowl 5 cm above plate (off-goal x offset 20 cm for negative), initial arm pose, fingers 4 cm/open or 0/closed; simulate 300 steps holding initial arm targets. No kinematic clamping after reset. Fixtures are explicitly not expert demonstrations or learned-policy results.
metric: Unchanged bowl-stable-v1-20261028, additionally inspect 300-step prefix and full reference-plus-hold separately; extension is a diagnostic, not v1 policy score.
physical_reset: mj_resetData before each episode; original collector ensure_clean_state before reference actions. CPU float32 state packing may differ from prior GPU/hidden reset runs.
execution: CPU-only; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; MUJOCO_GL disable; no rendering or checkpoints.
old_packages: Do not modify prior finalized outputs.
